summary: Implementation plan for VEDA VERSE: A Gen Z-tailored mobile-first platform celebrating Vedic and Hindu cultural heritage with AI Guru (Gemini 3.5 Flash / 3.1 Pro High-Thinking / 3.1 Flash-Lite), speech chant-along audio, interactive temple map, scripture and manuscript archives, story swipe cards, spaced-repetition flashcards, full-screen slide decks, quizzes, timeline/mindmaps, and a dedicated Atharvaveda-to-PubChem botanical bioscience explorer backed by Firebase Auth and Firestore persistence.
